_comment: Labelled (requirement, resume bullet) pairs for evaluating the matcher. label=1 means the bullet is genuine evidence that the candidate meets the requirement. Bullets are drawn from the synthetic resume.txt in this repo, so nothing here is personal data. This is a CURATED behavioural test set, not a random sample: it deliberately over-weights the cases the matcher must not get wrong (topically-adjacent negatives, paraphrases, degree levels). Precision/recall measured here describe behaviour on hard cases, not on the wild distribution.
